reason: This is the only offered combination and should show how the liver responds to glucagon.

reaction: The result matched my expectation, and the sequential insets made the feedback clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: The liver response was most worthwhile because it connected glucagon, stored glycogen and the reduction in the original signal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Setting up the post-meal body felt least engaging because it mainly established a situation already stated in the introduction.

surprise.text: Nothing was particularly surprising; the declining insulin and glucagon release made the feedback pattern clearer.

arbitrary.text: No combination lacked a clear purpose, though each decision offered only one combination, so there was little room for meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more decisions. This one explained the two responses clearly, but its sequence was predictable.
